description.en: Returns which version of the game is running: 0 (GAME_VER_DR) or 1 (GAME_VER_SH), the two editions of Inazuma Eleven GO (Dark and Shine, by the constant names).

0 or 1.
null if the script system is not ready.

examples.case: Content for one edition (real usage, from ev42034000.nut)
